title: Reranking: the second opinion
subtitle: Fetch many candidates fast (vector), reorder a few carefully
mission: The question "Can I claim my home internet?" needs two chunks: the one saying it isn’t reimbursed and the home office allowance one. Use a reranker to get both into the top 2 and find out how many candidates it needs.

predict.question: without a reranker, does hybrid search’s top 2 bring both answer chunks?

feedback.right: right: fast search puts the expense-claims chunk first, since it looks a lot like the question, but it doesn’t answer it. The home office allowance lands 3rd and falls out of the top 2.
feedback.wrong: only one: the expense-claims chunk looks a lot like the question and takes 1st place without answering anything. The allowance chunk, which completes the answer, lands 3rd.
feedback.skipped: no guess? Run with the reranker off and look at the final result.

coach.ui: guess noted. Turn the reranker off and run; then turn it back on.
coach.cmd: guess noted. Run rerank --rerank no and then --rerank yes.

tryNext.ui: Now the vacation + VR question, with 6 candidates and with 3. For a real reranker, pick "Your key" or "In the browser".
tryNext.cmd: Run rerank "Can I sell part of my vacation and how much VR do I get per day?" --candidates 3.

why.simples:
Fast search is like scanning a shelf and pulling 6 books that look right. The reranker reads each blurb carefully and picks the best 2.
But it only picks among the ones you pulled: if the right book stayed on the shelf, no miracle.
why.dev:
Two-stage retrieval: a cheap retriever (vector, BM25 or hybrid) brings k candidates, and a pricier reranker reads question and chunk together and scores relevance. Dedicated rerankers (cross-encoders like bge-reranker, or APIs like Cohere Rerank and Voyage) are faster and steadier than asking an LLM.
Final recall can never beat candidate recall: raise k until the right chunk is almost always among them, and pay the reranker’s latency only on those k.
why.especialista:
Bi-encoder embeddings compare vectors computed separately; a cross-encoder sees question and chunk in one pass and catches fine relations (negation, "isn’t reimbursable"). That’s why it’s more precise and can’t search the whole index.
Measure the (k, reranker) pair with recall@n and p95 latency. An LLM as reranker works but varies with the prompt and can return invalid JSON; on failure, fall back to the original order. Small models (1B) rerank poorly: use them only to demonstrate.

mission.ui: time to break it: keep the reranker on and lower candidates to 2.
mission.cmd: time to break it: run rerank --candidates 2

break.success: Broken: with only {n} candidates, the allowance chunk never reached the reranker. It reordered what it got and recall stayed at {recallPct}%. A reranker can’t find what the first search left behind.
break.calm: Recall {recallPct}% with {n} candidates and top {top}. To break it, give the reranker fewer candidates than the answer needs.

ui: Pick a question and hit Run.
"Candidates" is how many chunks fast search hands the reranker; "top" is how many go on to the LLM.
cmd: The question goes in quotes, after rerank.

errors.aboveMax.top: Up to 5 chunks for the LLM.

scene.label: Two-stage retrieval
scene.failNote: The model didn’t return JSON scores; kept the search order.
scene.simNote: Stage 1 is simulated vector search (hand-written similarities). The simulated reranker knows which chunks answer. Use "Your key" or "In the browser" for a real reranker.

chunkTexts: Vacation must be requested through the employee portal 30 days in advance and needs the manager’s approval.
Vacation can be split into up to three periods: one of at least 14 days and the others of at least 5 days each.
Employees can sell up to one third of their vacation (cash allowance), asking together with the vacation request.
The meal allowance (VR) is R$ 45 per working day; anyone may swap it for the grocery allowance (VA) of the same value.
The health plan covers spouses and children up to 24 as dependents, with co-payment on appointments.
The PLR profit share is paid in March, proportional to how well company and team goals were met the previous year.
Remote work is allowed up to 2 days a week, agreed with the manager at the start of each month.
Anyone with remote days gets a R$ 120 monthly home office allowance, paid with the salary.
Work expenses are reimbursed with an invoice uploaded in the expenses app within 30 days.
Home internet and electricity aren’t reimbursable: those costs are already covered by the home office allowance.
To change your portal password, go to My profile > Security or call IT extension 4000.
To use the VPN, install the corporate app and select the AUR-VPN-02 profile.
data.rerankSys: You grade chunks of an HR handbook. For the question, give each numbered chunk a 0 to 10 score for how much it helps answer. Reply only with JSON: {"scores":[n1,n2,...]} in chunk order.

steps: Take 3 questions of yours whose answer needs two chunks.
Fetch 10 candidates with your hybrid search and pass question + candidates to a reranker (BAAI/bge-reranker-base with sentence-transformers, or a rerank API).
Compare the top 3 before and after reranking.
recipe.ok: after reranking, both chunks of each answer are in the top 3, and with only 2 candidates that doesn’t happen.
